noticias_reales.title: Palantir Is Worth $413 Billion. The $500 Billion Line Sits Almost Exactly at Its Record High.
noticias_reales.summary: At Palantir's current share count of about 2.4 billion, a $500 billion valuation implies a stock price of about $208. The stock's record high of $207.52, set in early November, sits less than 1% below that level.

noticias_reales.title: Palantir vs. ServiceNow: Which Is the Better Long-Term AI Stock?
noticias_reales.summary: Two enterprise software leaders are pursuing the same enormous AI opportunity from opposite directions. See where their strongest advantages and biggest risks could emerge.

noticias_reales.title: Massive News: Palantir's Newest Partnership Could Strengthen Its AI Moat
noticias_reales.summary: Palantir (PLTR +10.32%) is pairing its mission-critical software with advanced AI hardware from Nvidia (NVDA +2.27%) to create a secure operating system for governments and enterprises. This deep dive examines whether sovereign AI could strengthen Palantir's moat enough to support its premium valuation.

noticias_reales.title: Palantir: The Market Finally Realizes Its Bear Case Makes No Sense
noticias_reales.summary: Palantir delivered a sensational Q2 silencing skeptics, with U.S. commercial revenue up nearly 150% and government revenue up 90%. PLTR's ontology layer and FDE model continue to anchor its robust growth, emphasizing AI sovereignty and value creation over "token self-pleasuring." Despite >80% FY2026 growth estimates, Wall Street expects deceleration in 2027, prompting a higher bar for management execution. The market will seek validation from Alex Karp and team.

noticias_reales.title: U.S. politician's super suspicious Palantir stock trade gains 30% in less than 3 months
noticias_reales.summary: United States Senator John Boozman's first reported purchase of Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) has drawn attention after the investment gained nearly 30% in less than three months.

noticias_reales.title: SpaceX, GameStop, Palantir and More: 5 Stocks Investors Couldn't Stop Buzzing About This Week
noticias_reales.summary: Retail investors talked up five hot stocks during the week (Aug. 3 to Aug. 7) on X and Reddit's r/WallStreetBets, driven by retail hype, earnings, AI infrastructure momentum, and corporate news flow.

For every $100 in sales, $37 is net profit — very profitable.
Generates real cash: $2.2B of free cash flow per year.
Owes $0.00 for every $1 of equity — low debt.
Quick score: 3.8/10, computed from 76 of 100 evidence points — categories without FMP data stay N/S (never fabricated).
